records.explanation: USA zahlen 0,1 Mrd. Dollar. Erst nach 30 ununterbrochen finanzierten Tagen wird ein weiterer zulässiger Nordstaat einmalig organisiert. Abbruch kostet die Vorleistung. Halabja braucht eine bereits gebildete PUK.

records.title: End the Kurdish support contract
records.description: Stop the common recurring subsidy and its advisers/target contribution. Money already spent is sunk; committed equipment stays recorded until delivered, seized or written off. Seed and pulse ledgers persist.

records.title: Write off the undelivered cache
records.description: Resolve an abandoned or settled clandestine commitment. The remaining equipment is lost and cannot be refunded or granted again. This permanently closes its delivery ledger.
records.explanation: Schreibt das noch nicht gelieferte Waffenlager endgültig ab. Kein Rückerstattungs- oder erneutes Anfangspaket.

records.title: Offer the recorded cache to KUR
records.description: Offer only the remaining previously committed equipment, after an actual rising or an agreed lawful settlement. Acceptance and route are checked again; no second initial grant is created.
records.explanation: Empfänger wählt, ob er nur die verbliebenen bereits zugesagten Waffen aus dem Lager annimmt. Kein zweites anfängliches Waffenpaket.

records.title: Offer the recorded cache to PUK

records.title: Emergency Security Appropriation
records.description: Pay 2% of current annual GDP once, then sustain a 90-day national military-overhead package. The smaller programme adds +35% army personnel/+20% equipment upkeep; the major adds +60%/+35%. Keep at least two actual divisions in the northern states for 30 days before the resistance reduction. One 90-day cooldown survives withdrawal and government change.
records.explanation: Irak zahlt 2% aktuelles BIP. Für 90 Tage nationale Personal-/Ausrüstungsmehrkosten +35/+20%. Mindestens zwei tatsächliche Divisionen müssen 30 Tage im Norden bleiben: dann Widerstand −15, eigener Zielbeitrag −20 für 60 Tage. Gemeinsame 90-Tage-Sperrfrist. Abzug beendet die Operation ohne Rückzahlung.

records.title: Major Northern Operation
records.description: Pay 4% of current annual GDP once, then sustain a 90-day national military-overhead package. The smaller programme adds +35% army personnel/+20% equipment upkeep; the major adds +60%/+35%. Keep at least two actual divisions in the northern states for 30 days before the resistance reduction. One 90-day cooldown survives withdrawal and government change.
records.explanation: Irak zahlt 4% aktuelles BIP. Für 90 Tage nationale Personal-/Ausrüstungsmehrkosten +60/+35%. Mindestens zwei tatsächliche Divisionen müssen 30 Tage im Norden bleiben: dann Widerstand −25, eigener Zielbeitrag −35 für 60 Tage. Gemeinsame 90-Tage-Sperrfrist. Abzug beendet die Operation ohne Rückzahlung.

records.title: End the Northern Operation
records.description: End exceptional personnel/equipment overhead and its own target reductions. Preparation expenditure is sunk; the 90-day cooldown, resistance and grievances remain.
records.explanation: Beendet außerordentliche Nord-Personal-/Ausrüstungskosten und eigene Widerstandsziel-Senkungen. Kein Geld zurück; Sperrfrist und lokale Missstände bleiben.

records.title: Reopen Kurdish Negotiations

records.conditions: always = yes

records.title: Fund Refugee Relief
records.description: Aid workers need a dependable supply route and the resources to restore damaged infrastructure. A sustained relief operation can help northern communities recover while the fighting and displacement continue.
records.explanation: USA: 0,5 Mrd. Dollar einmaliger Startaufwand, dann 90 Tage 0,025 Mrd. Dollar pro Woche; unter Limited War 0,020. Zugängliche zulässige Nordstaaten erhalten +25% Infrastruktur-Reparatur.

records.title: Maintain the Northern Safe Haven
records.description: Renew 90 days of protection logistics at $0.05 billion per week beyond ordinary deployed-force expenses. Accessible northern states under actual US/Kurdish control receive +0.10 local supply for their controller. Actual forces, access and local control remain necessary. This commitment does not remotely ban Iraqi movement or declare a US war.
records.explanation: USA: 90 Tage 0,05 Mrd. Dollar pro Woche für Schutzlogistik. +0,10 örtliche Versorgung nur in tatsächlich von USA/KUR/PUK kontrollierten Nordgebieten. Keine Fernsperre für irakische Truppen.

records.title: Manage Coalition Air Cover
records.description: Renew or withdraw the real 90-day air ideas. Renewal requires fresh host consent and recipient acceptance. Personnel costs continue during the earned term after host access loss; actual basing obeys normal diplomacy.

records.title: Respond to a Protection Crisis

records.title: The Price of Victory

records.description: The requested loan was refused. No treasury or debt changed. Its refusal does not block Iraq's independent military decisions.

records.title: The Kuwaiti Accounts
records.description: Iraq legally owns and controls both Kuwaiti states. Only the remaining Kuwaiti principal was cancelled: $[?COLDWAR_IRQ_gulf_kuwait_cancelled|3] billion. Other debt survives. A separate, one-use seizure can transfer only 25% of accessible Kuwaiti treasury, capped at 10% of Iraqi GDP, while Kuwait still exists and both states are occupied. No missing reserve is invented. The Price of Victory is removed and a 180-day building-repair programme begins. Existing oil follows native ownership and control; no extra resource deposit appears. International opposition to the invasion remains.

Zustimmende kurdische Empfänger erhalten CAS-Schadensminderung 25%, gegnerische Luftüberlegenheitswirkung −20%, Armee-Personalaufwand +5%. Die Boni sind national, kein Skript verbietet irakischen Flugzeugen ein Gebiet. Tatsächliche Einsätze brauchen normale Flugzeuge, Basen, Reichweite und Kriegsregeln.
